page.overview:
What is Isolated Hut?

Isolated Hut is located on the eastern shores of Hindarsfjall and is a popular spot for fishermen all across the island. It was recently abandoned after a pack of white wolves moved in.

Once the zone has been cleaned, 170 / 50 is awarded and a merchant will appear.
